crossRefs.note: Wrap up the covenant. Seal the law among my disciples.
He said to him, “What is written in the law? How do you read it?”
“But Abraham said to him, ‘They have Moses and the prophets. Let them listen to them.’
“You search the Scriptures, because you think that in them you have eternal life; and these are they which testify…
For if you believed Moses, you would believe me; for he wrote about me.
But if you don’t believe his writings, how will you believe my words?”
Now these were more noble than those in Thessalonica, in that they received the word with all readiness of mind…
The Scripture, foreseeing that God would justify the Gentiles by faith, preached the Good News beforehand to Abraham…
Tell me, you that desire to be under the law, don’t you listen to the law?
For it is written that Abraham had two sons, one by the servant, and one by the free woman.
From infancy, you have known the holy Scriptures which are able to make you wise for salvation through faith, which is…
We have the more sure word of prophecy; and you do well that you heed it, as to a lamp shining in a dark place, until…
Now go, write it before them on a tablet, and inscribe it in a book, that it may be for the time to come forever and…
Yahweh’s law is perfect, restoring the soul. Yahweh’s covenant is sure, making wise the simple.
Yahweh’s precepts are right, rejoicing the heart. Yahweh’s commandment is pure, enlightening the eyes.
The entrance of your words gives light. It gives understanding to the simple.
The wise men are disappointed. They are dismayed and trapped. Behold, they have rejected Yahweh’s word. What kind of…
“Therefore night is over you, with no vision, and it is dark to you, that you may not divine; and the sun will go down…
But if your eye is evil, your whole body will be full of darkness. If therefore the light that is in you is darkness…
But Jesus answered them, “You are mistaken, not knowing the Scriptures, nor the power of God.
But they worship me in vain, teaching as doctrines the commandments of men.’
Professing themselves to be wise, they became fools,
For he who lacks these things is blind, seeing only what is near, having forgotten the cleansing from his old sins.
But the path of the righteous is like the dawning light that shines more and more until the perfect day.
Let’s acknowledge Yahweh. Let’s press on to know Yahweh. As surely as the sun rises, Yahweh will appear. He will come…
But to you who fear my name shall the sun of righteousness arise with healing in its wings. You will go out, and leap…
We have the more sure word of prophecy; and you do well that you heed it, as to a lamp shining in a dark place, until…

translations.web: Turn to the law and to the covenant! If they don’t speak according to this word, surely there is no morning for them.
translations.bsb: To the law and to the testimony! If they do not speak according to this word, they have no light of dawn.
translations.kjv: To the law and to the testimony: if they speak not according to this word, it is because there is no light
translations.asv: To the law and to the testimony! if they speak not according to this word, surely there is no morning for them.
